dialogue.text: That gun ain't gonna shoot itself girl.
Chloe: AH- oh um... Yeah no, I've been ready... yeah for sure- I've done this before.. ahah.. phew.
Jasmine: Girl don't lie to me... I can see the nervousness on your face right now, haha.
Okay... dang it. I might be a tiny bit nervous. It's just... it's my first time doing something this big. A movie, with rich demon people...
And look at me, a nervous wreck. I can't believe it's actually happening. I really can't... like W-w what if my movie flops?
W-what if people hate it? All of these thoughts, my anxiety is through the roof right now!
Jasmine: I know, Chloe. You're not alone on this one. If I'm gonna be honest with you, I'm actually a bit nervous myself.
Chloe: Y-you don't look like it... you know, I bet you're saying that to make me feel better. How do you even manage?
Jasmine: How do I manage? I don't... I just try to do my best. And that's all we could ever do. Don't get me wrong, I'm still scared but you have take a leap of faith.
Look how about this; do you wanna rehearse together? We don't start filming until a few hours. Maybe it'll help both of us calm our nerves, y'know?
Yes! I would love to! Only if you don't mind! I don't wanna mess up and panic or anything.
Jasmine: Oh hush! You're gonna do great girl, come on. Let's walk.
So normally, I'd say to not have expectations in general because you'll just disappoint yourself when things doesn't go the way you expected.
But for stuff like this, expect to mess up. I know when I first started, mostly everyone made fun of me and- Chloe, I know you're not grabbing what I think you're grabbing.
Chloe: H-hand slipped while we were walking. S-sorry ma'am. However, yes, I guess I understand... we miss one hundred percent of the shot we don't take... screw it.
